事例研究 03 // FINANCIAL OPS CASE STUDY Client-Side Architecture

RAPA INVOICE GENERATOR

Project Spec Automated Financial Document & Billing Engine

A dedicated client-side billing application engineered for precast concrete manufacturing operations. Replaces fragile spreadsheets and paper carbon receipts with instantaneous multi-line item calculations, live document previews, and print-accurate Nota Penjualan & Surat Jalan generation.

COMMERCIAL FIN-OPS // 2026
CLIENT-SIDE REACTIVE ENGINE
01 / Overview

Executive Summary

For manufacturing operations in the architectural precast concrete sector, generating transactional paperwork — specifically Nota Penjualan (Sales Receipts) and Surat Jalan (Delivery Waybills) — is a daily mission-critical task. Previously, personnel relied on generic spreadsheet templates and manual paper ledgers, which frequently produced calculation discrepancies, lost records, and delayed driver dispatches.

Rapa Invoice Generator was architected as a lightweight, zero-latency desktop and tablet web utility. Built without heavy backend dependencies, it equips administrative clerks with an interactive form editor that renders a live, true-to-print commercial document preview on the fly with instantaneous mathematical tallying.

02 / Challenges

Engineering Hurdles

Delivering an enterprise billing utility directly in the client browser necessitated solving critical formatting, arithmetic, and printing constraints:

▶ Pixel-Perfect Commercial Print Formatting: Replicating exact standard Indonesian continuous stationery and A4 corporate invoice layouts with strict margin controls for laser and thermal print output.
▶ Complex Multi-Line Item Calculations: Dynamically recalculating piece counts (PCS), area coverage ($M^2$), tiered pricing, logistics/ongkir freight fees, and down payments (DP) without rounding errors.
▶ Dual Document Generation: Supporting instant one-click toggle between Sales Invoice (financial breakdown with banking coordinates) and Delivery Note (logistics manifest omitting pricing).
▶ Zero Server Overhead & Offline Tolerance: Guaranteeing full offline operation on warehouse tablets without requiring a recurring cloud backend or persistent internet connection.
03 / Solution

Client-Side Architecture

I engineered the solution using modular vanilla JavaScript (ES6+) and Tailwind CSS, emphasizing extreme lightness, deterministic performance, and zero dependency fatigue.

1. Two-Way State Binding & Live Mirroring

The UI is split into a streamlined configuration workbench on the left and an exact 1:1 paper document sheet on the right. Form inputs are bound via reactive DOM event listeners, updating tabular quantities, prices, and net balances on every single keystroke with zero measurable input lag.

2. Dynamic CSS Print Engine

A bespoke @media print stylesheet strips out all workbench controls, sidebars, headers, and backgrounds. It forces exact physical print dimensions, high-contrast monochrome ink lines, and page-break isolation so users get flawless physical documents via standard system print dialogs (window.print()).

3. Session Storage & Safety Auto-Save

Active invoice drafts are continuously serialized into browser localStorage. Clerks can accidentally close the tab or reload during busy dock operations without losing itemized order rows or custom client billing details.
